    <p>{`This is a configuration to apply static and dynamic filters that can work for connected and disconnected. This is an important use case because some combinations might not work as expected, for instance, declared filter in XML can be overwritten by the filter injected through API.`}</p>

    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Common Issues:`}</strong></p>

    <h2>{`Best Practices`}</h2>

      <li parentName="ul">{`Keep all filters in a single consistent format (either all in XML or all in code) to avoid conflicts`}</li>
